world_news.headline: More than 100 dead and buildings collapsed after 7.4-magnitude earthquake shakes Colombia – latest news
world_news.summary:
More than a dozen buildings collapsed in aftermath of earthquake, which has also prompted evacuations

People remain trapped in Cali, one of Colombia’s largest cities, ​after more than two dozen structures ‌collapsed, mayor Alejandro Eder said. ‌

He added that the city had asked authorities in Bogota and Medellin to send disaster teams ‌to support rescue efforts.

world_news.headline: Forever a Crow, Taylor Walker remains the boy from Broken Hill
world_news.summary: Taylor Walker arrived at the Adelaide Football Club as a 75-kilogram prospect who had only ever wanted to be a footballer. More than 300 AFL games and 700 goals later, he will retire as a club great.

world_news.headline: Trump signs order to limit childhood vaccines and split MMR shots
world_news.summary: The Trump administration recommends separating the measles, mumps and rubella vaccine into three different shots administered in separate visits.

world_news.summary: The pro-Kremlin nationalist party Rodina accused the Yabloko party of receiving undeclared campaign support.

world_news.headline: Greyhound badly injured in race supporting Tasmanian industry
world_news.summary: Greyhound races held under the name "We Stand With Tasmania", in support of the state's embattled industry, have featured a number of dog fall incidents which have been scrubbed from the record.

world_news.headline: 'We've had a lot of close calls': Canada wildfire evacuees wonder if they still have homes
world_news.summary: More than 12,000 people have been forced to evacuate and some homes have been lost after a wildfire tore through Canada's picturesque Okanagan region.

world_news.headline: Migrant children go days without food in Ceuta amid asylum crisis
world_news.summary: A surge of migrant children and families remained in makeshift shelters in Ceuta, Spain’s North African enclave.

world_news.headline: 111 dead after Colombia quakes leave trail of destruction
